title: Mode 2 pause/resume API gap
description: TermmuxDriverAdapter does not yet expose Pause/Resume methods. This blocks Mode 2 E2E test F4 (pause/resume race under output burst) and the TestPauseResumeLifecycleAPI test. Both are currently skipped. The adapter needs Pause() and Resume() methods wired through to the underlying termmux session lifecycle.
